_what: What the mint is told when a proposed agent name does not carry the ending its kind requires.
_why: Both sentences were written in JavaScript inside agent-roster.js — model-facing prose in engine code, unreviewable in the prompt layer and unchangeable per project. The shapes themselves are derived from the registry and arrive as a value; only the words live here.
_bodies: shapes — the shapes for this kind resolved. unknown — the registry could not be read, so the requirement can be stated but not the endings; saying so beats inventing them.

bodies.shapes: An agent of kind "__KIND__" must be named ending in __SHAPES__.
bodies.unknown: Rename it with the ending this pipeline requires for its kind.
